description: Full-text search of FamilySearch's Latin American notarial protocolos collection. Returns a single 1834 Cuban notarial entry recording a power of attorney granted to a witness named in the user's query. The skill is graded on whether it knows that FTS is the right tool for thin-index pre-1850 Latin American notarial sources — and whether it constructs a query using the recorder's likely spelling rather than an Anglicised form.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the active project directory. Supply it whenever the search will be logged (the normal case): the tool then stages its raw results host-side and returns a `staged.resultsRef` handle to pass to research_log_append as stagedResultsRef, so the results are retained without re-serializing them. Only omit it for a throwaway exploratory search you are certain you will not log.

results.title: Protocolo notarial — Poder otorgado por Don Francisco de Quesada
